baseline_selection.selection_boundary: Scaling and logistic coefficients fitted on train only; C selected by validation log loss, threshold by validation macro-F1. No test inputs accepted.

split.method: First fold of StratifiedGroupKFold(5, shuffle=True, seed=42) used as validation; rest train

C_selection: Validation log loss; listed C order breaks exact ties
threshold_selection: Validation macro-F1 across 0.10 to 0.90 at 0.01 steps; nearest 0.5 breaks ties
promotion_rule: Strictly lower validation log loss and strictly higher validation macro-F1, with Fight recall at least the baseline; otherwise stop at development results
selection_boundary: Seal development caches, fitted head and promotion decision before loading evaluation global arrays or extracting evaluation local features
limitations: Exploratory supervised RWF development on the same source-grouped split. The released evaluation clips have already been inspected in previous experiments. This is not an untouched test or an independent confirmation of generalization. No supplied labels changed. Independent human label review, near-duplicate and pretraining overlap audits remain pending. Whole-clip scores are not calibrated probabilities or person-level attribution.
